posts.body:
hi, im new. im 6 weeks preg with my 5th child, im so excited. we have 4 boys ( 1 rip) and we are hoping for another boy this time, this is the first time ive got sickness tho, i usually only get tierd. we have had alot of negative comments since we told people about the baby, but i am determined to enjoy every single second of it! 😜
how many of you have got 4 children?, how where those first few weeks after bubs was born?,
x thanx 😀

Welcome to JP and congrates on your pregnancy. I hope the sickness easiers off and that you fully enjoy your pregnancy. I don't know what it is like having more than 3 at home but for 16 very short days I was a mum of 5 and even though my twin's were in hospital I still found it very overhwelming and tried my hardest to get myself and my older 3 into a new routine ready for when I, even though it never happened I could bring my twin's home. I look forward to hearing about your pregnancy journey and I hope to the bottom of my heart that people start looking zat this pregnancy in a lovely way that it is. Every child is a gift and no-one should see the bad in a child and see a pregnancy as a negative thing as it is 100% positive. Enjoy and good luck

Hi there and big congrats on your pregnancy! 😘
I have just had (well, 5 months ago) baby number 3 but would definately like to extend to 4 in a couple of years- the other 2 are 12 and 6 years old.
At the end of the day- this is YOUR family and whoever thinks that you should only have so many should mind their own business! As long as each child gets time with you and your partner that's all that matters. 🙂
Hope you get over sickness soon, I was fairly lucky with my pregnancies- just felt tired! Only had mild sickness with the eldest and that was only when I was hungry, and it subsided after 1st trimester. 😀
Lou x
